Task message and done message types for replay and exec tiles.

# Purpose
This header file defines the message types and task identifiers used between the replay tile and the exec tiles. It assigns numeric values to exec task types such as `FD_EXEC_TT_TXN_EXEC`, `FD_EXEC_TT_TXN_SIGVERIFY`, `FD_EXEC_TT_LTHASH`, and `FD_EXEC_TT_POH_VERIFY`, and it also defines the active epoch values for `FD_SIMD0180_ACTIVE_EPOCH_TESTNET` and `FD_SIMD0180_ACTIVE_EPOCH_MAINNET`. The `fd_exec_task_msg_t` union carries task requests from replay to exec, with fields for transaction execution and signature verification, while the `fd_exec_task_done_msg_t` structure carries completion notices back to replay with the transaction index and error status. These definitions provide the shared data layout needed for task dispatch and completion tracking across execution stages.
